datasets.name: SYSDAT
datasets.sql:
select to_date('01-jan-'||to_char(tek_dat,'YYYY')) as begindat,tek_dat,add_months(tek_dat,-12) olddat,
       to_date('01-jan-'||(to_number(to_char(tek_dat,'YYYY'))+1)) as enddat from sysdat
